entries.title: Psalms 36:1
segments:
Saith within my heart; is conclusive evidence to me. 
 
The conduct of wicked men shows the state of their hearts, and none are the friends of God who do not make it their great object habitually to obey him.

entries.title: Psalms 36:2
segments:
He flattereth himself; that he is good, notwithstanding all his iniquities. 
 
Wicked men live in contrast self-flattery and self-delusion.  Thus they keep themselves ignorant of their true character, and encourage themselves in a life of sin, till they perish without remedy.

entries.title: Psalms 36:3
segments: When men neglect to do what they know to be right, they deliberately do what they know to be evil; and unless restrained by the grace of God, will grow worse and worse till they perish.

entries.title: Psalms 36:5
segments: The glorious perfections of God infinitely surpass every thing in nature; and are a sure foundation of confidence to all who trust in him.

entries.title: Psalms 36:7
segments: By the loving kindness of God many are led to trust in him, and thus to learn that in the keeping of his commands there is great reward.  In his presence their is fulness of joy, and at his right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

entries.title: Psalms 36:8
segments: Fatness of thy house; its abundant spiritual provisions.  The meaning of the psalmist is, that he shall be admitted, as a member of God's spiritual family, to dwell in his presence, and be filled with joy from the light of his countenance.  Of this, communion with God in his earthly sanctuary is an earnest and a pledge.

entries.title: Psalms 36:9
segments:
The fountain; God is the author of life, and all its blessings flow from him. 
 
  In thy light shall we see light; God is the uncreated source of light; when he shines upon the souls of his people, they see light. Light is here put for salvation in the widest sense.

entries.title: Psalms 36:10
segments: Know thee; in such a manner as to trust in and obey thee.
